transcript: Speaker A: C for cat, D for dog jaisi angrezi toh seekh li, lekin aaj tak English mein dhang se sentence tak nahi bol paate ho. Aise toh tumhari koi izzat nahi karega. Yahan sirf sikhane wali videos aati hain, koi ads nahi aate. English Seekho app pe spoken English yaani bolne wali angrezi ka ek show aata hai. Experts chhote-chhote videos mein step-by-step English bolna sikhate hain. Toh bas roz ka 15 minute nikalo, expert ke videos dekho, AI coach se practice karo. Trial sirf ek rupaye ka hai. Phir dekhna, kuch hi dino mein tumhari English dekh ke log dang reh jayenge. [You learned basic English like C for cat, D for dog, but still cannot speak proper sentences. No one will respect you like this. Instead, practice English for 15 minutes daily on this app. This app is called English Seekho. It has only educational videos and no ads. It features a spoken English show where experts teach step-by-step. Just spend 15 minutes daily watching expert videos and practicing with the AI coach. The trial is only 1 rupee. Soon, people will be amazed by your English.] Speaker B: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, Disclaimer: English Seekho kisi bhi government authority, institution, brand, organisation ya individual ke dwara endorsed, sponsored, affiliated ya associated nahi hai... summary: An AI-generated child on stage warns viewers that poor English speaking skills lead to a lack of social respect. He recommends the English Seekho app, highlighting its ad-free expert videos, AI coaching, and a 1-rupee trial. The ad concludes with a call to action to install the app.
